clock.production_activation: NONE; external accepted Strict/O proof and controller approval required for any future integration

timeframe_roles.1D: CONTEXT_RISK_ONLY; countertrend allowed with warning and half paper risk budget
timeframe_roles.4H: REGIME_STRUCTURE_ATR14_OBSERVABLE_LEVELS; opposing regime vetoes READY, retains WATCH
timeframe_roles.1H: PRIMARY_CLOSED_BAR_RECOVERY_OR_REJECTION; confirmed pivots and fixed geometry create WATCH
timeframe_roles.15m: NEW_COMPLETED_RECOVERY_OR_REJECTION_OF_FIXED_1H_CLOSE; only upgrades a preexisting valid 1H setup

methodology.regime: sign of last close minus fourth-last close; RANGE allowed
methodology.primary_long: latest low <= prior close AND latest close > prior high; short symmetric
methodology.pivot: strict extremum with one completed left and one completed right bar
methodology.atr: mean of last 14 true ranges using previous close
methodology.stop: most recent confirmed protective 1H pivot +/- 0.20 * ATR14, beyond structure
methodology.entry_region: 1H setup close +/- 0.15 * ATR14; immutable; worst side used for R
methodology.targets: nearest 2 or 3 distinct favorable confirmed 1H/4H pivot prices; no projected R-multiple targets; TP3 optional
methodology.15m_long: bar opens at/after 1H setup end, ends after WATCH registration; low <= open <= fixed 1H close < 15m close inside entry zone; short symmetric
methodology.readiness: new signal + current source admission + refreshed 1D/4H risk context + no stop/TP1 touch + no chase + positive stress planned TP1 R + plausible response window
methodology.context_refresh: every admitted review recomputes current 1D/4H context, including late context receipts; fixed 1H entry/stop/targets and candidate ID do not change; RANGE allowed
methodology.missing_15m: finished 1H WATCH preserved; no MTF READY
methodology.repeated_15m: consumed even when refused; cannot reissue or extend prior READY
methodology.terminal: INVALIDATED or EXPIRED stays terminal for same 1H setup; a newer valid 1H setup must register fresh WATCH
methodology.restart: all research state in memory; restarted engine registers WATCH and cannot recover prior READY

time_policy.planned_extension: optional, declared at construction, longer than base hold, maximum 24h; funding uses full planned extension
time_policy.hold_lifetime_anchor: hypothetical actual fill, never WATCH or READY; no fill exists here
time_policy.review_window: min(entry expiry, new confirmation end+15m) - review >= declared response; control uses entry expiry
time_policy.response_instruction: recheck source, zone, stop and target at response; cancel if invalid, expired or out of zone; no future price guarantee

source.interval: UTC exchange-aligned [open_ms, exclusive_end_ms); inclusive exchange closeTime = exclusive_end_ms - 1
source.causality: end <= exchange_observed_lower <= received <= available <= review; no future request or row
source.quote_causality: exchange_time <= review_exchange_lower; exchange_time <= received <= available <= review
source.gaps: strict ascending consecutive opens AND exact requested range edges; no omitted or duplicate bars
source.revision: revision must equal 0; changed OHLCV/identity content at retained observed key quarantines symbol; later unchanged receipt is allowed
source.bounded_admission: maximum 64 bars per symbol/interval batch; retain last 64 immutable identities per stream; reject cross-snapshot gaps and watermark rewind
source.monotonicity: per-symbol review as-of and per-symbol/interval accepted end cannot rewind
source.staleness: required 1D/4H/1H end age <= interval+2m; optional 15m/5m absence/staleness keeps WATCH but cannot qualify corresponding entry gate
source.protected_boundaries: any overlapping request or bar excluded, including synthetic rows on protected dates; holdout gets specific reason before broader protected exclusion
source.quarantine: malformed source symbol stays quarantined in ledger; no silent repair or denominator shrink
source.global_veto: explicit source veto, unproven clock or as-of rewind latches SOURCE_BLOCKED across symbols; operator must discard engine and requalify externally
source.atomicity: all rows validated before any features; no partial ledger fingerprint commit on failure

costs.funding: adverse full funding windows rounded upward, including a short hold crossing a funding boundary
costs.paper_size: min(paper risk budget/(stop distance+max stress TP cost), paper notional cap/entry, 10% of minimum visible bid/ask size if quote exists)
costs.capacity: quote is top-of-book only; 5m-only capacity unknown; size is a paper scenario cap, no account authorization or fill guarantee; gaps can exceed modeled loss

collector.transport: OfflineStub ONLY; no network implementation; raw responses are unadmitted
collector.universe: sorted unique caller-predeclared USDT symbols, 1..50; fixed denominator includes quarantined/unavailable/no-setup symbols
collector.catchup_excess: quarantine whole symbol; never truncate history or silently fill gaps
collector.polling: at most one declared cycle/minute; bars requested only when a new completed interval exists; planner reserves 2000ms close uncertainty; no immediate retries
collector.weight_qualification: PINNED_OFFLINE_ASSUMPTIONS_NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED; future transport must independently verify authoritative endpoint/rate policy before activation
collector.individual_failure: discard partial symbol responses, quarantine symbol, continue other symbols, fixed denominator
collector.global_failure: shared endpoint failure or all symbols quarantined vetoes entire collection; no partial eligible set

paired_control.shared: same ordered snapshots, universe, source gate, 1H geometry, 1D/4H risk, costs, entry expiry and actionability; same candidate ID
paired_control.difference: no 15m directional filter; one 1H signal consumed at first readiness attempt; path monitoring/refusal uses 1H/5m/quote only
paired_control.pair_id: SHA256 of symbol, review timestamp and MTF candidate ID
paired_control.comparison: eligibility states only; no forward fills, returns, realized R or alpha invented
